description: This file defines Flask routes and functions for a blogging application, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting posts, with user authentication and database interactions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays all blog posts ordered by creation date.

methods.name: get_post
methods.description: Retrieves a specific post by ID, optionally verifying authorship.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new blog post for the current user, with form validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing post if the current user is the author.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a post if it exists and the user is the author.
